skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of environmental concepts, structure, function of the environment, and human impacts on the environment.
Understand the historical development of natural environmental components, their characteristics, and current issues related to these components.
Understand the levels of ecological organization, relationships between ecosystem components, and productivity of ecosystems.
Understand the management of renewable and non-renewable resources, their exploitation levels, and depletion risks.
Apply knowledge of environmental science to explain natural phenomena and analyze human impacts on the environment.
Have the ability to learn independently, find information to complete assignments and solve practical problems.
Be aware of organizational discipline, follow classroom rules, have teamwork spirit and personal responsibility for assigned activities.
